steps.speaker: Scarface
steps.content: Win-win-******* win! Damn fine work, Commander! You're running this show no worse than the boss! Maybe we oughta make it permanent?

steps.speaker: Scarface
steps.content: I was just kidding! Quit staring at me through that broken slit of yours! You're making my skin crawl here!
The reliable lieutenant—codename, fittingly, "Lieutenant"—has already secured the necessary arrangements.

steps.speaker: Lieutenant
steps.content: Detail three soldiers for cleanup. All other units move out immediately. Recon Team at 67B just lit up our boards. We've got a narrow window to secure the advantage.

steps.speaker: Scarface
steps.content: Alright, I'm going in! See ya all later—
After the battle, the sandstorm's fury has dulled to a whisper, just as predicted. Visibility sharpens by the minute, and the Tide of Ashes begins its sluggish turn away from the battlefield.

Now, the cleanup team moves in. They keep the feed live at your command, scanning the wreckage with methodical efficiency. Soon, they discover the shattered husk of the mysterious device you marked for destruction.

steps.speaker: Military Doctor
steps.content: Completely obliterated, isn't it... No question it was vectoring the Tide straight toward the FAC outpost.

steps.speaker: Military Doctor
steps.content: Chief, can you see this?
It's an Aurum Secretum device, the same kind the Outlanders use to resonate with some Apostles of Ashes, siphoning power from them. But this one is different.

Between its slotted grooves, something festers. A nauseating contamination, thick and dormant. Just watching the feed makes the shackles within you twitch, like a chain yanked taut by some distant call.

That might be Mania contamination unique to the Black Ring. Worse, the device wasn't just tuned to the Apostles. The evidence suggests a deeper resonance that matches the very Black Ring you've hunted for a long time.
BR-005, where Hella disappeared.

steps.speaker: Military Doctor
steps.content: ...We can handle that, but are you planning to conduct the examination personally, Chief?

steps.speaker: Military Doctor
steps.content: The contamination on this device seems abnormal, unlike anything we've seen. In your state, close exposure would risk severe physical strain. My team can handle the examination, and we'll provide a full diagnostic report. Otherwise...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No. Just bring it back. I have to—
[Contamination Flash]

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Ugh!!
Hecate catches you just before you collapse face-first into the sand table, but it's too late. The chaotic noise has already clawed its way into your mind.
Get back... Help me... Get out of here...!! Hurry over here... GET BACK... Come to me... HELP ME!
The world around you twists, reality fraying at the edges. You struggle like a drowning man, your resistance desperate yet futile as you fight to move forward.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't be ridiculous... I can't stop... How can I stop here...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Bring it back... I must get it... get her back...
And then, with one final, shuddering step forward, you reach out—
[Fade to Black]
Only to walk into darkness.
